description:
The Rapide Carbon is designed to be fast!

The race proven Rapide Carbon transfers the power directly to where you need it, providing rapid response and sharp handling to make sure you complete the hottest lap. This bike has already raced in some of the biggest XC races, as well as prove itself on the demanding marathon epics. The Rapide Carbon is your perfect podium hunter

The Rapide CRS is built to be fast, light, and performance led. With the superb 100mm Rockshox SID Select forks with OneLoc remote to lock out suspension on the fly providing maximum speed on the climbs. Shimano's performance 1x12 SLX wide range drivetrain ensures you have enough gears for even the steepest climbs. Shimano's M6100 brakes give you enough stopping power for the rewarding descents.

This race machine rolls on WTB KOM Light rims paired with a Schwalbe Racing Ray/Racing Ralph tyre combo for a perfect blend of speed and grip. Vitus components complete this race ready XC bike.

Carbon XC Frame with Boost spacing

Rockshox SID Select 100mm W/ Oneloc
